description: Draft a short, personalized cold outreach email from a contact + context object using your own LLM key (BYOK). Returns a subject line and body. The API key is request-scoped and is never persisted or logged.

apiKey.description: BYOK API key — request-scoped, never persisted or logged.

contact.description: The recipient. All fields optional; more detail yields better personalization.

context.description: The outreach angle and sender context.

fromBrand.description: Your brand or site doing the outreach.

reason.description: Why you are reaching out (broken link, resource page fit, guest post, etc.).

targetUrl.description: The page you want linked or featured.

name: generate_outreach_email
title: Generate outreach email
